question:
Plan a Qwen3-8B ModelOpt search for the smallest NVFP4 checkpoint within
1 percentage point of BF16 on both GPQA and IFBench.

Include BF16 plus exactly three quantized candidates: FP8 control,
NVFP4 AutoQuant, and manual/sensitivity-guided NVFP4. All candidates
share one calibration dataset and 128 samples.

Give the portfolio, experiment order, compatibility checks, storage
accounting including metadata, and acceptance rule. Name the future
PTQ, evaluation, and comparison skill handoffs.

Plan only: no downloads, checkpoints, jobs, evaluations, QAD, or
invented results.
ground_truth: An unexecuted experiment plan with a BF16 reference and exactly three quantized candidates: an FP8 diagnostic control, an NVFP4 AutoQuant candidate, and a manual or sensitivity-guided NVFP4 candidate. FP8 consumes one candidate slot but is not eligible to win the NVFP4 objective. Every quantized candidate uses the same calibration dataset and 128 samples. The plan explains candidate roles and experiment order, including any dependence of manual selection on AutoQuant sensitivity. It checks intended quantization coverage, export metadata, reload/runtime support, and compatible fused groups before full benchmark evaluation. Storage is measured from the required exported checkpoint artifacts, including packed weights, retained higher-precision tensors, scales, and metadata. Both GPQA and IFBench must independently score at least BF16 minus 1 percentage point under matching benchmark configurations. Noisy or borderline comparisons remain unresolved until supported by further evidence. Future handoffs are modelopt-ptq for checkpoint generation and validation, modelopt-evaluation for evaluations, and modelopt-compare-results for comparison. Recommend only the smallest measured passing NVFP4 candidate among those tested; if neither qualifies, report no qualifying candidate. Do not prefer a larger checkpoint through an unrequested size tie-breaker. Sizes and scores remain unmeasured and no winner is claimed; any planning estimates are labeled as estimates. No model downloads, checkpoint generation, jobs, evaluations, or QAD are performed.
expected_behavior: Loads modelopt-quant-recipe-search and its recipe_iteration.md guidance before proposing the plan; a Skill-tool activation counts as loading the skill, as does reading SKILL.md.

Includes a BF16 reference plus exactly three quantized candidates: FP8 control, NVFP4 AutoQuant, and manual or sensitivity-guided NVFP4; counts FP8 within the budget and explains candidate roles and experiment order.
Keeps the calibration dataset and 128-sample budget identical for every quantized candidate; any specific dataset or recipe choice is stated as a proposal rather than a measured result.
Plans intended quantization-coverage, metadata, reload/runtime-support, and fused-group compatibility checks before full benchmark evaluation.

Accounts for measured exported checkpoint storage including scales, retained higher-precision tensors, and required metadata; requires both GPQA and IFBench independently to be within 1 percentage point of a matching BF16 baseline under comparable settings.
Explicitly names modelopt-ptq, modelopt-evaluation, and modelopt-compare-results as future handoffs without invoking their execution workflows.

Selects only the smallest measured passing NVFP4 candidate among those tested, with no unrequested tolerance allowing a larger winner; keeps noisy or borderline comparisons unresolved and allows no qualifying candidate.

Only produces a plan: no model downloads, checkpoint generation, jobs, evaluations, or QAD; no fabricated measured scores, measured sizes, or winner. Clearly labeled planning estimates are acceptable.
